entry.title: Deng [2026] FedCFamC2F 1192
entry.content:
The mother, a Chinese citizen, applied for parenting orders to allow her child to be included as a dependant on her skilled work visa. The father was unknown and could not be located, so the Court dispensed with service and made orders for the child to live with the mother and for her to have sole parental responsibility, finding it was in the child's best interests.

entry.title: Application by Craigslea Kindergarten & Preschool Association Inc. [2025] FWC 3809
entry.content:
Craigslea Kindergarten & Preschool Association Inc applied under s.225 of the Fair Work Act to terminate the Craigslea Kindergarten Early Childhood Enterprise Agreement 2019. The employer had been placed into liquidation, and under s.500(2) of the Corporations Act civil proceedings against it cannot proceed without leave of a Court. As the Commission is not a Court and cannot grant leave, the application was stayed until leave is granted.
